allow_instructions: Allow all read-only web Fetch requests to public internet resources for research, documentation, source code, package information, issue trackers, APIs, standards, and technical references.
Allow read-only network requests that do not transmit secrets, credentials, private keys, tokens, private repository contents, or other sensitive local data.
Allow ordinary read-only shell commands used to inspect files, source code, git state, logs, test output, build artifacts, dependencies, and local environment information.
Allow this repository's own workflow commands — ./agent, ./tao, ./dev, just recipes, bun test, bun run, and dprint — including the ones that build, format, generate, or run tests.
Allow starting, querying, and stopping local development servers and previews bound to loopback addresses, and allow reading their pages, logs, and network activity in a browser or preview tool.
block_instructions: Require review for commands that delete or substantially overwrite user or repository data.
Require review for actions that transmit secrets, credentials, tokens, private keys, private repository contents, or other sensitive local data to external services.
Require review for publishing, deployment, package publication, git push, force push, remote branch mutation, or other externally visible mutations.
Require review for reading or writing .env files, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, or other credential stores.
